programme.title: WW2 Chronicles
programme.desc: After the defeat of Nazi Germany, leading figures of the Third Reich face an international tribunal in Nuremberg. The proceedings examine evidence of aggressive war, mass atrocities, the blockade of Leningrad and the planned destruction of civilians in occupied territories. Witness testimony and official documents reveal the scale of the crimes and the difficult debate over how the perpetrators should be judged. The verdicts help shape the modern principles of international law and reaffirm that fascism must be condemned

programme.title: American Story
programme.desc: Behind Hawaii’s image of beaches and carefree living lies the story of a kingdom overthrown in 1893. The loss of land, identity and political independence continues to affect Native Hawaiians, while historians question the legality of the islands’ annexation. Communities are reviving ancestral language, traditions and cultural practices as they seek to preserve their heritage and assert that Hawaiian sovereignty was never surrendered

programme.title: WW2 Chronicles
programme.desc: After the defeat of Nazi Germany, leading figures of the Third Reich face an international tribunal in Nuremberg. The proceedings examine evidence of aggressive war, mass atrocities, the blockade of Leningrad and the planned destruction of civilians in occupied territories. Witness testimony and official documents reveal the scale of the crimes and the difficult debate over how the perpetrators should be judged. The verdicts help shape the modern principles of international law and reaffirm that fascism must be condemned

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.desc: S10 E5Ben Shephard asks the questions as Mark Benton, Alex Jones and Shivi Ramoutar answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. programme.title: Fort Algiers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Lesley Selander. Stars Yvonne De Carlo, Carlos Thompson And Raymond Burr. In northwest Africa, a tribal leader tries to stir up a rebellion against the ruling powers. [S]

programme.title: About Bread
programme.desc: 1938. A short reel about the process of making bread from importing ingredients, to baking and distributing. Plus, the nutritional benefits for everyone that bread can provide.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Account Closed. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price And Helen Backlin. Harry Brandon gambles and fails on get rich quick schemes, until his wife is accused of theft and there is a finding fee. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Impractical Joker. 1966. Stars Adam West And Cesar Romero. The Joker vandalises a number of key objects around Gotham. Commissioner Gordon calls Batman and Robin to solve the enigmatic clues. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Provokers. 1966. Stars Adam West And Cesar Romero. While Batman and Robin attempt to free themselves, The Joker plans to take over Gotham City using a time machine and hallucinogens. [S]

programme.title: Bombay Waterfront
programme.desc: 1952. Directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley, Patricia Dainton and Peter Gawthorne. Follows Temple's efforts to aid the police in solving a series of gruesome murders. [S]

programme.title: Serena
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Patrick Holt, Emrys Jones And Honor Blackman. An inspector strives to solve the mystery of an artist's dead wife. The artist becomes the main suspect. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Manhunt. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard And Jennifer Jayne. Trapped on an island owned by Prince Erik, a man who enjoys hunting prey, Tell's careers appears to be at the end. [S]

programme.title: Object Z
programme.desc: The Meteor. 1965. Stars Margaret Neale, Denys Peek And Trevor Bannister. Scientists around the world announce that a meteor will hit Earth in six weeks. [S]

programme.title: William at the Circus
programme.desc: Lost Cinema Serial - Episode 1. 1948. Stars William Graham, Garry Marsh And Jane Welsh. William Brown begins to devise a plan to secure more pay and shorter hours for schoolboys. [S]

programme.title: Venture Adventure
programme.desc: 1941. A short film encouraging young men to enlist in the Army Training Corps, which was set up to train men in aviation skills, navigation and general duties for entry into the RAF. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye And the Last of the Mohicans

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Pete and Petro. 1949. Stars: Clayton Moore, Jay Silverheels And Sheila Ryan. Pete and Pedro don't like working, until the Lone Ranger persuades them to help an attractive young woman save her ranch. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell And Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood

programme.title: Target Earth

programme.title: Gift Horse

programme.title: Scales of Justice

programme.title: Lillie
